programme.title: It's time for Halloween
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are getting ready for a Halloween party, but when JoJo accidentally squashes their spooky pumpkin lantern, they need a replacement! Luckily Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan!

programme.title: Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: The Round Up Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels go on the trail of a lost herd of cattle with Duggee and his old pal Rodeo Horse, who teaches them how to be cowhands... and earn their Round Up Badges in the process!

programme.title: The Game Show Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels have played all of their board games, so Duggee entertains them by putting on a Game Show, with some help hosting from his good friend Ladybug.

programme.title: Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Floating Farms, Bangladesh
programme.desc: While clearing up the Academy farm after a heavy storm, the Go Jetters wish they could keep the plants above water. Glitch remembers a place where the farmers do just that - Bangladesh, where many farmers grow their crops on wooden platforms to avoid floods in the monsoon season.

programme.title: Runner Beans
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, it's the speedy dancing runner beans!

programme.title: Pak Choi
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's your favourite show host, Pak Choi, who might be known by many names, but sings about how she's "Always Pak To You!"

programme.title: Veggie Magic
programme.desc: When Evil Pea poses as a magician so that she can use tricks to make the Tato Team 'disappear', Supertato and Carrot create their own magical plan to rescue them.

programme.title: Tato Tower Takeover
programme.desc: Evil Pea and the Mini Peas take over the Tato Tower HQ and lock Supertato out.

programme.title: Trailer
programme.desc: When it's time for the Tubby Custard Ride, there's a special trailer the Teletubbies haven't seen before. It's for The Noo-­Noo who gets to go on a special Tubby Custard Ride.

programme.title: Treasure
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'treasure' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. Today, we find lots of different treasure - gold treasure, royal treasure, sunken treasure, jungle treasure and even yummy treat treasure! Dee and a friend have a go at juggling treasure and we see Dee hide some treasure.

programme.title: Space Cucumber
programme.desc: A copycat space seed crash lands on Farmer Fuddles's farm, and Messy is keen to help. It soon grows into... Messy! Can there ever be such a thing as too much Messy? OKIDO is about to find out.

programme.title: Turbo Ted
programme.desc: Ted the bus wants to be faster, and Mojo swops every top to try to make it happen. But it's Bo's homemade rocket that gives Ted the boost he needs... all the way into space!

programme.title: Granny Mobile
programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.

programme.title: Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: The Why Badge

programme.title: 巨轮II
programme.desc: 罗威信（萧正楠）与姚文英（田蕊妮）几经艰辛，将「罗信记」发展得誉满港澳，却惹来迭码仔出身的地产商高天鹫（吴岱融）不满，施横手连翻打压，威信更被亲信徐知力（杨明）所出卖，感世俗混乱，遂到日本冲绳寻找宁静空间。期间，恋上了神秘少女高伊娜（陈凯琳），更卷入一宗廿年前离奇凶案！另一方面，文英丈夫龙飞（阮兆祥）遇上撞机意外，脑部受创，竟视文英为陌路人…加上为寻找旧爱卓静(钟嘉欣)的乔天生（陈展鹏）回归，威信与文英面对突如其来的亲情、爱情及事业的新冲击，应如何去面对？

programme.title: 新四十二章
programme.desc: 猪肉档老板娘朱萤娇(龚嘉欣饰)天生神力，却得了会生胡须的怪病，渴望寻找「四十二章经」宝藏内的神药治病。大学中文系教授章经(陈豪饰)多年前已醉心寻找这个传说中的宝藏，惟因一次事故大受打击，一直饱受失眠症困扰。数学天才邵桂芝(江嘉敏饰)机灵聪敏，对急症室病房男护士柯建宁(周嘉洛饰)一见倾心。桂芝游走于正邪之间，也极想找到宝藏，以求一朝发达。章经、萤娇和桂芝因缘际会之下相遇，为抢夺宝藏而各出奇谋，争夺过程中开展了人性的善恶争战，斗过你死我活……

programme.desc: 秀惠的父母罗启钊、曾萍丽惊闻女儿死讯，赶去认尸，悲痛欲绝。定勤通知可岚，指秀惠并非死于硬物袭击而是死于窒息，所以初步可排除秀婷是凶手嫌疑。日进预视到启钊推秀婷下楼的画面，同时警方亦接报启钊欲对秀婷不利，日进和可岚要阻止惨戏发生。可岚在秀惠衣服上有发现新毒品线索，怀疑凶手其实是秀惠的男友有关！

programme.title: 珠玉在侧
programme.desc: 苏玨一意买断玉石，特邀墨山玉石矿主斯家长子斯如初前来洽谈。斯如初为自己想垄断全国各色玉石计，如约来见苏玨，两人一拍即合。听闻斯如初到来消息，单单一行急忙找去客栈，却见苏玨在旁，多有言语讥讽。得知斯如玉的斯家次子身份，单单忙邀其至裴府小住，极力讨好。 既知裴家做玉心思，斯如玉直言他才是助裴家回归正道的关键。在见识了裴沛精湛的技艺后，心中已是了然。

programme.desc: When Thunder’s clan of fellow Nightlights is attacked by the Snow Wraith, Tom vows to rescue them.

programme.title: First Flight: Part 1
programme.desc: Moving to an exotic new home, an adventurous teenager meets a new group of kids and discovers a dragon in the fissure.

programme.title: An Uphill Battle
programme.desc: The Dragon Knights make a deal for the Storm Wheel but first must obtain the other Storm Wheel from a mysterious mad scientist. Though Mastodon continues to warn the team about the dangers in using the Tianshang Weapons, they use them in a fight against Klaus and Veruca. The clash of the weapons wakes a dormant volcano!

programme.title: The Mad Scientist
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blade's brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 1
programme.desc: As the Dragon Knights prepare to battle for the weapons and control of Tikal, Mastodon attempts to teach Po how to access storm powers to use in the fight. Blade comes face to face with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: The Empty Well
programme.desc: The kids are low on supplies in the Sahara and stumble on a town with a well that has mysteriously run dry. The crew decides to investigate and discovers a Cleve Kelso-controlled water facility that’s stealing water from the village. They manage to blow up the facility, but it alerts Rafaela and Matsuo to their whereabouts.

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: In an awesome chase/battle through the desert, the crew goes up against Rafaela, Matsuo, and Sandocal - who are driving the kids’ own cars. The crew struggles to fight back while also not losing the trail to Cleve’s base in the desert. When Rafaela turns on Sandocal, he and Layla decide to work together and manage to overpower Rafaela and Matsuo. Sandocal tells the kids to go to escape toward the Bedouin Shield.

programme.title: The Bedouin Shield
programme.desc: It’s revealed that Cleve is building a massive weather machine that is generating dangerous desert storms, with the help of a genius North African teen named Ziri. When Cleve creates a sandstorm to take out the crew, they’re saved by two Bedouin brothers named Kareem and Salem (and their pack of camels). Echo questions her ability to be a good leader and if they should give up.

programme.title: Airheads
programme.desc: When Jim is unavailable to do a simple Trollhunter task Toby and Claire take on the responsibility to prove they can carry their weight... literally.

programme.title: Where Is My Mind?
programme.desc: When Pixies attack Arcadia Oak High the students and faculty must fight their greatest fears Jim faces Angor Rot which takes an unlikely turn.

programme.title: 阴阳刀
programme.desc: 大侠张七郎退隐江湖多年，他的妻儿及朋友却被鬼头党所杀。悲愤的七郎打算独力与鬼王决一生死，为他们报仇雪恨！恶名昭彰的鬼头党最终会被他打败吗？

programme.title: 弟子也疯狂
programme.desc: 方世玉、洪熙官与胡惠干三位俗家弟子初入少林，拜于南院戒嗔大师门下习武。然而，三人常与出家弟子悟清较劲切磋，寺中从此喧嚷不绝，连方丈见此情景亦不免啼笑皆非。

programme.title: 六刺客
programme.desc: 镇国公李明恃强作恶，鱼肉百姓。他的兄长虽是当今圣上，却对李明的恶行束手无策。正气凛然的剑客穆俊杰假扮成李明的护卫密谋刺杀行动。他先捉拿六名欲杀李明的刺客，再与他们结盟，密谋杀死李明以终止其暴行。

programme.title: 清宫启示录
programme.desc: 清朝两位太子为要争夺帝位，令人民死伤无数。被牵连在这场皇室斗争当中的女刺客，最终能否及时执行刺杀任务以助其中一位皇子登上皇位？

programme.title: 黑店
programme.desc: 故事讲述，江湖上传出消息，巡抚海刚峰辞官归里，所携箱箧中珠宝价值连城，于是引起了一些歹人的觊觎。高家店店主高山峰、其姘妇邓三娘，以及数帮黑道人物，均于高家店埋伏，准备等待海刚峰经过之时伺机下手…

programme.title: 武则天
programme.desc: 武则天有倾国之貌，绝世才华，十四岁时更被唐太宗召为才人，但太宗死后却入寺为尼，却又与继位之唐高宗有染，生有二子。时皇后与萧妃争宠，命武则天回宫以制妃子，却反陷害皇后。武则天获封皇后之后，更诛杀两太子。直到高宗病亡，武后临朝，成为史上第一个女皇帝。

programme.title: 毒龙潭
programme.desc: 樊瑛受歹徒唐大川欺骗，盗去师父的玉龙剑，并生下一子一女；后樊遭师罚禁毒龙潭，唐抱子虞江逃走，女青儿则归师公门下；二十年后，剑再次被盗，青女扮男装，私下寻剑，却遇樊旧友天涯客...

programme.title: 我们恋爱去了
programme.desc: 一次偶然机会下，富家子大用巧遇育幼院院长之外甥女连莲。二人初次见面，双方即发生误会，大用更在匆忙间遗下皮包。当大用硬将连莲假装成为自己的未婚妻好让两个倾慕他的女子死心时，又与连莲发生了第二次误会...

programme.title: 疯猴
programme.desc: 陈百精通「猴拳」，但却被恶霸设计陷害，更废了他双手。陈百终沦落为流浪艺人，直到遇上街头小子小侯，决将一身「猴拳」，倾囊相授。最后师徒二人联手，势要一雪前耻。

programme.title: 乔太守乱点鸳鸯谱
programme.desc: 孙玉郎与刘慧娘，裴政与徐雅本是两对情投意合的恋人，阴差阳错间，孙玉郎男扮女装代姐拜堂，刘慧娘则代兄娶妻。他们的婚约误配，让成误会，终闹上公堂，乔太守将错就错，干脆来了一个乱点，结果正好有情人终成眷属，皆大欢喜。

programme.title: 千门八将
programme.desc: 尽窥赌术内幕的影片《千门八将》讲述，正将是道上叱咤风云的"赌王"。一次，他在与"赌魔"的赌局中，被其暗算而隐恨退出江湖。二十年后，赌魔以计迫使正将重出赌坛，正将被赌魔以千术击败，含怨吐血而亡。正将之子为报父仇，邀其请昔日与其父亲出生入死的拍档"千门八将"与赌魔展开连场赌博......
